name: LTE (LTY's transit expansion)
description: LTE 是 MTR（Minecraft Transit Railway）的交通拓展：为列车加上动态车头灯、车尾灯与可见光柱，并带来雨雾与溅起的水花、列车碰撞与撞飞、信号灯 / 投影机 / PIDS 连接器、3D 光束编辑器，以及一批厦门风格的屏蔽门等方块。服务端同时安装时，碰撞、撞飞与伤害在服务端结算；只装客户端也能照常使用。\nLTE is a Minecraft Transit Railway expansion: dynamic head and tail lights with visible light beams, rain mist and spray, train collisions that knock you flying, signal / projector / PIDS linkers, an in-game 3D beam editor and a set of Xiamen-style platform screen doors and props. Install it on the server too and collisions, knock-back and damage are resolved server-side; client-only installs still work.
authors: 厦航在拍车的无名机长 (kigurumiLTY)
